fieldNotes.truckGate: Open shared truck court between Building I (1030, NFI) and the adjacent Building II (1240). 2025-12 Street View at the SW court intersection shows no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point across the truck drive — the park road opens directly into the dock court. A chain-link perimeter fence is visible around the building landscaping but the truck court entry itself is uncontrolled.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at the court entrance in 2025-12 Street View; the only structures are a monument sign and light poles. Class A spec building with no staffed gate.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate at all (no controlled entrance), so this cannot be a gate-without-guard configuration.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved truck court west of the dock face provides interior holding/queue space before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The court approach from the park road into the dock apron easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open court apron with ample unused paved width — physical room to add an express/bypass lane if access control were installed.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Savannah Business Journal / CBRE listing: Building I has 54 dock doors. Satellite confirms a continuous dock line with dock levelers and trailers backed in along the west face → 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Listing states 95 trailer-parking spaces for Building I; satellite z19 shows extensive marked trailer stalls in the shared court → 50+.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~14 trailers counted backed-in / parked in the captured imagery (approximate; some hidden by building shadow).
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: 95 trailer stalls per the CBRE/SBJ spec; honest estimate, not counted door-by-door.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single shared court drive lane in and out; lanes not individually striped at an entrance, so counts are low-confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town spec logistics park off S H Morgan Pkwy near I-95; tree-lined with a residential subdivision to the SW. Small-town/edge-of-metro industrial → Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated shared trailer-storage court with 95 marked stalls separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; this is a truck/transload import warehouse.
